acceptance: A unit test with a mocked PR view returning CONFLICTING/DIRTY shows pr-arm exits on the first iteration with an outcome line naming the conflict, a non-zero exit distinct from a refusal for failed checks, and no arm call
A test with mergeable UNKNOWN then MERGEABLE keeps waiting and then evaluates the gates as before
docs/agent/merge-authority.md or the pr-arm help names the conflict outcome and the recovery step
description:
## Problem
When a pull request conflicts with its base, GitHub does not run the `pull_request` CI workflow, so the core job that records the verify-fast-duration verdict never starts. `scripts/pr_arm.py` reports `waiting: ... no verify-fast-duration verdict is recorded for <head>: the core job that records it has not finished` and keeps polling until WAIT runs out. It never reads `mergeable`/`mergeStateStatus`, so the real cause is never named (no `CONFLICTING`/`DIRTY` handling in scripts/pr_arm.py on develop 9ac60f085f).

## Evidence
2026-11-16, PR #4266 at head f7ff00f29: two `make pr-arm PR=4266 WAIT=60` invocations waited about 50 minutes on that message. Only `review-gate` and `review-verdict` runs existed for the head; `gh pr view 4266 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus` returned `CONFLICTING DIRTY` (develop had merged #4260, touching the same files).

## Change
Read the PR's mergeable state at the start of each wait iteration. When it is `CONFLICTING` (mergeStateStatus `DIRTY`), stop with an outcome line that names the conflict and the next step (merge or rebase develop, push, re-arm). Treat `UNKNOWN` as transient and keep waiting.

## Guardrails
- Never arm a conflicting PR and never resolve a conflict automatically.
- An unreadable mergeable state is not a pass; keep the existing refusal semantics for unreadable state.
- Keep the `pr-arm: outcome:` line contract (see pr-arm-red-develop-refusal-prints-no-outcome-line-20261101).

## Decision gate
No owner decision is needed. Stop and ask if detecting the conflict requires a new GitHub token permission or a change to the merge-queue or auto-merge settings.

## Verification rubric
Pass only if: a conflicting PR produces a conflict outcome within one iteration; no code path arms a CONFLICTING PR; transient UNKNOWN does not end the wait; existing pr-arm tests still pass.
